address: 1076 Charoen Krung Road, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: Samlor means ‘tricycle’ in Thai and a traditional one hangs outside this cosy restaurant. Inside the loft-style space, chef Napol creates flavoursome, well-presented elevated Thai cuisine inspired by local street food with specially selected ingredients. They also have an à la carte menu, which includes a cut and catch of the day. Guests need to check with the chef what is available....
